title: [clinic · EX-13] Route α by query class
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-13` — Route α by query class](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-13-route-by-query-class.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Routing on the question's surface form rather than on a measured per-class α. If you have not measured that the classes want different α, routing adds machinery for nothing.

**2.** Fitting α per class on the same data you evaluate on.

**3.** Too many classes. Each class's α is fitted on a fraction of the eval set, and the noise band per class widens accordingly.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-13]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
